title: Driver Support Reference Card: Report Volume, Denials and Reconsideration — Cleaning and Damage Fees
content:
Figures the driver support desk applies to Cleaning and Damage Fees reports, by fee level.

| Fee level | Report review threshold | Report lookback | Reconsideration window | Reconsiderations per assessment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) | 4 reports | 30 calendar days ending on the report date | 7 calendar days after a denial | 1 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | 4 reports | 30 calendar days ending on the report date | 7 calendar days after a denial | 1 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | 4 reports | 30 calendar days ending on the report date | 7 calendar days after a denial | 1 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | 4 reports | 30 calendar days ending on the report date | 7 calendar days after a denial | 1 |
| Damage Fee (Interior Repair) | 4 reports | 30 calendar days ending on the report date | 7 calendar days after a denial | 1 |
| Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) | 4 reports | 30 calendar days ending on the report date | 7 calendar days after a denial | 1 |

## What the figures mean

- **Report review threshold.** The number of reports by one driver within the lookback at or above which new reports go to Trust and Safety instead of support: 4.
- **Report lookback.** The window for counting a driver's reports: 30 calendar days ending on the report date.
- **Reconsideration window.** The calendar days after a denial within which the driver may ask for reconsideration with new evidence: 7.
- **Reconsiderations per assessment.** At most 1.

## Recorded grounds for denying a report

At every level a denial is recorded with one of these grounds:

- filed outside the window
- evidence deadline missed
- below receipt minimum
- non-chargeable condition
- duplicate report
- trip not completed
